items.name: Åsane Open 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Åsane Open. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### Nye Deltakere Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AsaneOpen2024#50402-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to to Åsane Open! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete. ### New Competitors There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors tab.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AsaneOpen2024#50402-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors)

items.information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) **Adding/Dropping Events** - Competitors may request via the contact form to be added to more events BEFORE registration closes. - Competitors may not add events after registration closes. - Competitors may request via the contact form to remove events from their registration. It is also acceptable to not show up for any event you do not wish to compete in, although it is not encouraged. - Competitors may also adjust their registration details by themselves, without prior approval until the registration deadline If Registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In order to get on the waitlist, you must register and pay. You are not on the waitlist until you pay the registration fee. If you do not make it off of the waitlist, you will be fully refunded. If a competitor drops out, the first person on the waitlist will replace them. People can be replaced up until the registration close date indicated above. *In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.*

items.name: FMC Greek Nationals 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgxNjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--db49adff55638d00cf908aad968093aad8933de0/image.png) Mια εβδομάδα πριν ξεκινήσει το 2ο Εθνικό Πρωτάθλημα Cubing θα πραγματοποιηθεί το αγώνισμα του FMC (Fewest Moves Challenge, Δοκιμασία λύσης 3x3 με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις) για το εθνικό πρωτάθλημα του 2024. Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες σχετικά με το FMC Greek Nationals 2024. *Tην ίδια μέρα μετά την ολοκλήρωση του αγωνίσματος του FMC θα πραγματοιποιηθεί στον ίδιο χώρο και η συνάντηση όλων των Cubers πριν από το πρωτάθλημα (Pre Nationals MeetUp) Σημαντική Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στη WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) One week before the 2nd National Cubing Championship, the FMC competition for the Greek Nationals 2024 (Fewest Moves Challenge) will take place. Please read the following pages in detail to find all the necessary information. *On the same day after the completion of the FMC competition, the meeting of all the Cubers before the championship (Pre Nationals MeetUp) will take place in the same place Important Note: In order for a registration to be considered complete, the registration must be completed on the WCA competition page AND the payment of the participation fee must be made using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the tabs next to .

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.
